nodes.name: manifest-v5-preregistration.md
nodes.summary: Pre-registration document for Waggle substrate benchmark Stage 3 N=400 run (Manifest v5), specifying RPM-throttled execution with concurrency lowered from 2 to 1, updated judge ensemble RPM limits, hypothesis, stopping rules, scope boundaries, and PM gates.
nodes.languageNotes: Structured scientific pre-registration document with 32 sections covering hypothesis, sample design, model stack, substrate, deviation policy, and gates. Supersedes v4 manifests.

nodes.name: manifest-v5-preregistration.yaml
nodes.summary: Machine-readable YAML encoding of the v5 benchmark pre-registration manifest, covering dataset parameters, subject model routing, judge ensemble configuration with RPM limits, substrate settings, stopping rules, budget, deviation policy, and PM gates.
nodes.languageNotes: 46 top-level YAML sections including judge_ensemble, substrate, kappa_monitoring, confidence_intervals, failure_taxonomy, stopping_rules, and validation_gates — the machine-authoritative counterpart to the .md narrative.

nodes.name: manifest-v6-preregistration.md
nodes.summary: Pre-registration document for Waggle substrate benchmark Stage 3 N=400 run (Manifest v6), documenting the judge ensemble swap, kappa re-calibration methodology, MiniMax failover behavior, and extended parent-chain traceability over v5.
nodes.languageNotes: 40 sections with new Phase 1 kappa re-calibration gate (§5.4), disqualified-candidate audit trail, and dual-phase gates (Gate P++, Gate P+++) representing the most structurally significant delta from v5.

nodes.name: manifest-v6-preregistration.yaml
nodes.summary: Machine-readable YAML encoding of the v6 benchmark pre-registration manifest, adding judge_tertiary_v6, judge_backup_v6, kappa_recalibration_v6, and kappa_monitoring_runtime sections alongside all inherited v5 configuration.
nodes.languageNotes: 49 top-level YAML sections — largest in the v5/v6 pair, reflecting the expanded judge ensemble and kappa re-calibration protocol added in this version.

nodes.name: manifest-v7-gepa-faza1.yaml
nodes.summary: Comprehensive machine-readable pre-registration manifest for the GEPA Phase 1 benchmark (Manifest v7), covering GEPA corpus design, mutation oracle, faza_1_acceptance criteria, judge metric design, F-saturated baseline rule, cost governance, 11 sequential amendments, and a SHA-256 audit chain for tamper-evidence.
nodes.languageNotes: The largest file in this batch at 1606 lines with 65 top-level YAML sections and 11 tracked amendments each carrying its own SHA-256 hash. The audit_chain_terminus field and per-amendment hashes form a tamper-evident integrity chain — a notable research rigor pattern.

nodes.name: manifest-v8-gaia2-preregistration.md
nodes.summary: Pre-registration document for the GAIA 2 Ambiguity+Adaptability Ablation benchmark (Manifest v8), specifying ARE/GAIA 2 dataset design, the hive-mind substrate lifecycle per scenario, I/P/B frame integration contract, agent ReAct loop with hive-mind hooks, and a three-gate PM approval process.
nodes.languageNotes: 35 sections with a dedicated substrate section (§6) documenting how the hive-mind memory substrate integrates with GAIA 2 scenarios — the first manifest to cross-reference the @waggle/core substrate and the I/P/B frame contract.

nodes.name: manifest-v8-gaia2-preregistration.yaml
nodes.summary: Machine-readable YAML encoding of the GAIA 2 benchmark pre-registration (Manifest v8), including ipb_frame_contract, contradiction_gate, agent_architecture, sigalrm_fix, and build_tasks_before_phase1_codefreeze sections.
nodes.languageNotes: 36 top-level YAML sections; notable additions vs prior manifests include ipb_frame_contract (I/P/B memory frame lifecycle), contradiction_gate, and sigalrm_fix documenting a platform-specific signal handling fix required for the ARE execution environment.

nodes.name: manifest-v8.1-multi-benchmark.md
nodes.summary: Multi-benchmark programme amendment (Manifest v8.1) expanding waggle benchmark scope to four tracks: BEAM (Track A), GAIA 2/ARE (Track B), LongMemEval-V2 (Track C), and Terminal-Bench 2.0 (Track D), with per-track hypotheses, runability assessments, budgets, and cross-benchmark claim architecture.
nodes.languageNotes: 37 sections covering four benchmark tracks. Track-specific gate identifiers (Gate A-P+, Gate A-D, Gate V8C-PM) extend the prior binary gate scheme into a multi-track approval matrix.

nodes.name: manifest-v8.2-final.md
nodes.summary: Final scope amendment (Manifest v8.2) superseding v8.0 and v8.1, confirming the four-track execution order with BEAM first, deferring LME-V2 to a v9 placeholder, reaffirming the central scientific claim, and summarizing budget across all active tracks.
nodes.languageNotes: The shortest document in the batch at 110 lines; serves as the authoritative final scope resolution, with a v9 placeholder created by the LME-V2 deferral note.
